title: What is the atom ID of double bonded carbon in TR012 molecule?
question: What is the atom ID of double bonded carbon in TR012 molecule?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM AtomDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN AtomMolecule AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR012'
  AND T3.bond_type = '='
  AND T1.element = 'c'
  AND (T1.atom_id = T4.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T4.atom_id2)
